title: ScanCandidate array
description: Response body of POST /v1/identify. Every consumer decodes exactly this shape; nothing from the upstream provider is passed through unmapped.

id.description: Stable identifier for this candidate within one response.

title.description: Human-readable candidate name. For health results, the observation, never a diagnosis.

scientificName.description: Binomial name when the candidate is a species; null for health observations.

confidence.description: Normalized score. Presented to people as a possibility, never as certainty.

detail.description: Supporting context and the limits of the result.

source.description: Attribution for where the suggestion came from.
